SNAPSHOT_BEGIN_RULE: Acquire native observation barrier for exact qualification/generation registry revision, capture expected roster+kernel birth/descriptor epoch, use fresh owned reader connection, BEGIN READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ before any projection
SNAPSHOT_END_RULE: All explicit source collections complete; reread barrier/kernel generation and volatile census; exact reader backend PID/start/context unchanged, no lost/overflow observation; commit/rollback read-only, independently witness digest before health
CONSISTENCY_BOUNDARY: Catalog MVCC on one backend/transaction; volatile pg_stat_activity and external native registry/kernel facts require separate before/after applicability and no-changing-enrollment barrier. MVCC alone does not freeze stats or external processes
SNAPSHOT_ID: SHA256 typed context + expected manifest/policy + exact reader authenticated backend PID/start + MVCC snapshot identity + barrier revision + all ordered source digests
BACKEND_OR_SESSION_IDENTITY_RULE: Actual owned proxy connection and reader backend PID/start, no reconnect/helper equivalence. Native probe session does not replace non-target final consumer session
CATALOG_REVISION_OR_EQUIVALENT_RULE: Trusted TEST admin/DDL exclusion while native generation sealed plus fixed MVCC snapshot and independently unchanged native observation barrier; no claim that catalog has a universal monotonic revision column
RETRY_RULE: Discard incomplete snapshot as UNKNOWN; new independently authorized read only after same lineage/pending state remains consistent; never merge rows across attempts
CONCURRENT_CHANGE_RULE: Any catalog/role/body/ACL expected identity drift or native/backend census applicability drift => UNKNOWN; no optimistic repair/adopt live extras
RECONNECT_RULE: New reader session identity and full fresh snapshot; never complete old pending observation with rows from new backend
RESTART_RULE: Old generation/current tip preserved; new process cannot reset UNKNOWN or revive retired data
